categories.name: مَشَاهِدُ الْآخِرَةِ فِي سُورَةِ الطُّورِ
categories.nameEn: Scenes of the Hereafter in Surah At-Tur

items.verseEn: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,

items.verse: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
items.verseEn: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

items.verse: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
items.verseEn: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

categories.name: ألفاظ هلاك الأمم السابقة في سورة الأنبياء
categories.nameEn: Terms describing the destruction of past nations in Surah Al-Anbiya

items.verse: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍۢ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةًۭ وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
items.verseEn: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.

items.verse: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
items.verseEn: And when they [i.e., its inhabitants] perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.

items.verse: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَـٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
items.verseEn: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."

items.verse: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَـٰمِدِينَ
items.verseEn: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].

categories.name: المصطلحات القرآنية في الردّ على عقيدة الدهر في سورة الجاثية
categories.nameEn: Quranic rebuttal of the 'dahr' (time) materialist doctrine in Surah Al-Jathiyah

items.verse: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهْرُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
items.verseEn: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.

items.verse: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
items.verseEn: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

items.verse: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍۢ جَاثِيَةًۭ ۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍۢ تُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَـٰبِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
items.verseEn: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.

items.verse: هَـٰذَا كِتَـٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
items.verseEn: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."

categories.name: أَسْئِلَةُ التَّوْبِيخِ فِي سُورَةِ الْقَلَمِ
categories.nameEn: Rhetorical Questions to Disbelievers in Surah Al-Qalam

items.verseEn: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn

items.verse: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
items.verseEn: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.

items.verse: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
items.verseEn: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.

harf.hint: A secret ploy or scheme — a covert plan, often with ill intent, woven against an adversary.
harf.verse: 86:15 - Indeed, they are planning a plan,

deduction.title: The Mission in the Ancient City
deduction.intro: A dusty ancient town, its people entrenched in denial, and a final warning that went unheeded. Today, step into the role of those sent by Allah to deliver a message to a stubborn people. A story of rejection, a singular voice of faith, and an ending sealed by a devastating decree. Who speaks through these clues?
clues: We were sent by Allah to a town whose people had turned away from truth
Two of us came first, then a third joined to strengthen our mission
The townsfolk rejected us, saying we were nothing but humans like them
A single soul from the farthest end of the city ran to tell the people to follow us
We pled with them, but they hardened their hearts and turned against us
In one devastating cry from the heavens, our entire city was silenced

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: The Messengers of the Town in Surah Ya-Sin
The Hawwariyyun (Disciples of Isa)
The Sorcerers of Pharaoh's Court
The Companions of the Sabbath
The People of the Elephant
identity.answer: The Messengers of the Town in Surah Ya-Sin

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Rejected and called liars by the townspeople
Burned alive in a great blazing fire
Swallowed by a great fish in the deep sea
Forced to labor building a towering pillar
Tortured in a trench of raging fire
trial.answer: Rejected and called liars by the townspeople

location.label: Key Element
options: The ancient town (al-Qaryah)
A great blazing furnace
The belly of a great fish
The lofty sky-touching pillar
The sacred House (Kaaba)

outcome.label: Outcome
options: The town was destroyed by a single devastating cry (Sayha)
The tyrant and his army were drowned in the parted sea
The people were transformed into apes and monkeys
A rain of stones from the sky destroyed the city
A violent flood swept away the entire community
outcome.answer: The town was destroyed by a single devastating cry (Sayha)

deduction.arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
deduction.verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)

translations: And never will you be able to deal justly between
[the] women even if you desired but (do) not incline
(with) all the inclination and leave her (the other) like the suspended one
And if you reconcile and fear (Allah) then indeed
scramble.hint: A humble confession of wrongdoing and a heartfelt appeal for Allah's forgiveness and mercy.
scramble.arabic: وَلَن تَسْتَطِيعُوٓا۟ أَن تَعْدِلُوا۟ بَيْنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتُمْ ۖ فَلَا تَمِيلُوا۟ كُلَّ ٱلْمَيْلِ فَتَذَرُوهَا كَٱلْمُعَلَّقَةِ ۚ وَإِن تُصْلِحُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا
scramble.verseEn: And you will never be able to be equal [in feeling] between wives, even if you should strive [to do so]. So do not incline completely [toward one] and leave another hanging. And if you amend [your affairs] and fear Allāh - then indeed, Allāh is ever Forgiving and Merciful.

root.meaning: It centers on badness, harm, or fault. Its derived words express evil or wrong acts, a bad condition, and the worst kind or degree of something.
